statement: Usage traditionnel : traitement symptomatique des irritations de la bouche ou du pharynx et de la toux sèche associée (effet adoucissant).

source.title: European Union herbal monograph on Althaea officinalis L., radix (EMA/HMPC/436679/2015)
source.quote: Traditional herbal medicinal product used as a demulcent preparation for the symptomatic treatment of oral or pharyngeal irritation and associated dry cough.

statement: Usage traditionnel : soulagement symptomatique de gênes digestives légères (effet adoucissant).

source.quote: Traditional herbal medicinal product used as a demulcent preparation for the symptomatic relief of mild gastrointestinal discomfort.
